blocks.text: Amid her rumored romance with businessman Jacob Ang, Atasha Muhlach declared that she is single and that she has never had a boyfriend. The actress spoke about this during her “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” interview on Monday, Oct. 12, sharing the relationship advice she received from her parents, actors Aga Muhlach and Charlene Gonzales. “They just always tell me that, ‘If it makes you happy, it makes you happy.’ Parang as long as they have a good heart,” Atasha said.
